test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

One of the guest speakers who addressed the seminar (1)/ and interacted with students (2)/ were praised widely for their clarity and enthusiasm (3)/ during the closing ceremony. (4)

options.text: were praised widely for their clarity and enthusiasm (3)
One of the guest speakers who addressed the seminar (1)

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary error lies in the subject-verb agreement in part 2 of the sentence.
 
• The subject, "One of the guest speakers," is singular, and thus the verb should be "**was praised**" instead of "**were praised**."
 
• Using a plural verb ("were") with a singular subject results in a grammatical inconsistency.
 
• Therefore, the correction must focus on ensuring the verb agrees with the singular subject.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"One of the guest speakers who addressed the seminar and interacted with students **was praised** widely for their clarity and enthusiasm during the closing ceremony."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "and interacted with students"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "during the closing ceremony"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "One of the guest speakers who addressed the seminar"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
